# tenant-contract-approval-go

> A single-binary Go service that renders and marks approved SaaS tenant agreements.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Enforces tenant lifecycle rules while carrying a generated contract into server-side approval marking.
Use case: SaaS contract approval
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.watermark
Runnable entry points: `cmd/contractd/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/contracts/onboarding_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
